mapper.select: SELECT * FROM friend WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_id = #{targetId}

SELECT f.friend_id, f.status, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.real_name, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.department, u.class_name, u.title, u.user_type FROM friend f JOIN user u ON (f.target_id = u.user_id) WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 1 UNION SELECT f.friend_id, f.status, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.real_name, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.department, u.class_name, u.title, u.user_type FROM friend f JOIN user u ON (f.user_id = u.user_id) WHERE f.target_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 1

SELECT f.friend_id, f.status, 'received' AS direction, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.real_name, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.department, u.user_type, f.create_time FROM friend f JOIN user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.target_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT f.friend_id, f.status, 'sent' AS direction, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.real_name, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.department, u.user_type, f.create_time FROM friend f JOIN user u ON f.target_id = u.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE friend SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE friend_id = #{friendId} AND target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friend WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_id = #{targetId}
